#!/usr/bin/env bash
# The agent's test loop (DESIGN.md §15): build, start the whole app, run ONLY the specs currently
# present in e2e/specs (the agent sees only its own checkpoint's spec — blind), then stop.
# PINNED — do not edit. Contract: BASE_CHECKLIST.md §C, §D.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

export PORT="${PORT:-3000}"
export BASE_URL="http://localhost:${PORT}"
# Known audit file, shared by the app (bin/start) and the specs (support/audit.ts). Absolute.
export AUDIT_FILE="${AUDIT_FILE:-$PWD/.run/audit.log}"

bin/build
bin/start
cleanup() { bin/stop || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT

# Wait for readiness (Actuator health), then run the Playwright specs against BASE_URL.
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if curl -fsS "${BASE_URL}/actuator/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done

# Install deps + the Chromium browser (both cached after first run), then run the specs.
( cd e2e && npm ci --silent && npx --yes playwright install chromium && npx playwright test )
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the whole app into ONE runnable jar. The Maven build runs the front-end (frontend-maven-
# plugin) into src/main/resources/static, then packages the Spring Boot app (spring-boot repackage,
# main net.officefloor.hq.app.Application) into target/*.jar. PINNED — do not edit.
# Contract: BASE_CHECKLIST.md §B, §C. Must succeed from a clean base-empty checkout (§A).
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

# One command: the pom's frontend-maven-plugin builds the SPA into src/main/resources/static.
# `clean` first so removed sources (e.g. a deleted route .yml or class) can't linger in
# target/classes and get baked into the jar (found via the cp01 dry run).
exec ./mvnw -q -DskipTests clean package
# TODO: add the Maven wrapper (./mvnw) or switch to `mvn` if a system Maven is guaranteed.
